## Get numbat container
```{bash}
#| eval: FALSE
sbatch sbatchCmds/build_numbat_sing_container.sh
```


```{bash}

apptainer exec -b /work:/mnt/mydata -it pkharchenkolab/numbat-rbase:latest /bin/bash
singularity shell \
  --no-home \
  --cleanenv \
  --bind $(pwd):/mnt/mydata \
  --home "$(pwd):/mnt/mydata" \
  --pwd /mnt/mydata \
  sing_numbat_container.sif

/numbat/inst/bin/pileup_and_phase.R \
  --label testLabel \
  --samples testSample \
  --bams output/cellranger_out/G0001/possorted_genome_bam.bam \
  --barcodes output/cellranger_out/G0001/filtered_feature_bc_matrix/barcodes.tsv.gz \
  --gmap /Eagle_v2.4.1/tables/genetic_map_hg38_withX.txt.gz \
  --snpvcf input/numbat/genome1K.phase3.SNP_AF5e2.chr1toX.hg38.vcf.gz \
  --paneldir input/numbat/1000G_hg38/ \
  --outdir testnumbat \
  --ncores 4

```

```{r}

library(numbat)

g01 <- qs2::qs_read("output/01_process_raw/rdata/individual/G0001_human.qs2")

count_mat_ATC2 = readRDS(url('http://pklab.med.harvard.edu/teng/data/count_mat_ATC2.rds'))
df_allele_ATC2 = readRDS(url('http://pklab.med.harvard.edu/teng/data/df_allele_ATC2.rds'))

# run
out = run_numbat(
    GetAssayData(g01, layer = "counts"), # gene x cell integer UMI count matrix 
    ref_hca, # reference expression profile, a gene x cell type normalized expression level matrix
    read.delim("testnumbat/testSample_allele_counts.tsv.gz", sep = "\t"),
    genome = "hg38",
    t = 1e-5,
    ncores = 4,
    plot = TRUE,
    out_dir = './test'
)

```
